title: Enumeration of the one-bit Boolean cube
statement: On the one-dimensional Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^1$, whose points are the functions from a single-element index set to $\{0,1\}$, the set of all points consists of exactly the two constant functions: the one taking the value $0$ (false) and the one taking the value $1$ (true).
replaced:
The universal finite set of points of $\mathrm{BoolCube}\,1$ equals the two-element set
$\{(\_ \mapsto \mathit{false}),\ (\_ \mapsto \mathit{true})\}$.
